settings.objective: CE + 0.1 self-generated repeated-fourgram UL every10updates + 1.0 causal repeated-fourgram completion unlikelihood within past64 completion positions on unique non-special candidates excluding the true next token; same raw targets

sequenceUnlikelihood.prefixSelection: First sampled TRAIN row, true first min32 tokens including own BOS; no heldout prefix
sequenceUnlikelihood.normalization: sum repeated generated-target penalties / all generated positions
sequenceUnlikelihood.dropoutRng: fork_rng CPU; restore global CE dropout RNG and model mode

settings.schedule: Hold exact Round11 terminal LR throughout additional10000; preserve moments and RNG, no restart
settings.validationStatus: Previously exposed development sources; not independent unseen validation
settings.batching: Conditional length buckets64/128/256; same marginal row probabilities, correlated batch lengths; no target truncation. Different update trajectory from unbucketed pilots.
